rows.response_contract: Admitted provider read returns 202 RunRef; an unapproved write returns a typed PlanRef awaiting approval; an approved write returns 202 RunRef. Eventual ActionResult is complete by default or explicitly selected while preserving nesting, presence, exact values, source membership, counts, unread tail, completeness and continuation. No provider I/O runs inline in the API.
rows.idempotency: F01 scoped durable acceptance: current authorization before replay disclosure; exact key+canonical intent returns original acceptance without capacity reservation or redispatch, changed intent 409, unknown commit reconciled only with the same key.
rows.client_validation: UX-only generated typed parsing, explicit workspace and no provider secrets; persist a secret-free key/intent fingerprint before the first client-to-API send. Make at most three same-key sends inside 30s with deterministic 250ms/1s backoff; a server Retry-After must fit the remaining client deadline and never constrains provider/run retry timing. Never mint a replacement key, rebase a stale revision or resubmit 410; the server repeats authorization and contract checks.
rows.server_validation: Authentication, explicit scope, resource grant, If-Match where mutable, typed schema, bounded bytes and admitted capability. Shared typed preflight precedes provider I/O; authorization/scope precedes replay disclosure; run/outbox/pending reservation commits atomically before 202; enforce exact F01 finite count/age decision and ActionResult/pagination fidelity.

rows.request_contract: Typed delegation grant intent with explicit connection/operation/workspace/time ceilings and expiry, If-Match for the delegation collection revision, and a scoped idempotency key bound to workspace/principal/operation/target.
rows.response_contract: Original successful grant/create: HTTP 201 safe scoped identity/grant/revision and distinct actor/effective-actor metadata. Exact replay: HTTP 200 explicit replay plus the original safe result/revision. Never expose a provider credential or one-time PM automation credential.
rows.idempotency: Current authorization precedes lookup. Exact same scoped key+canonical intent replays original safe result with no effect; changed intent 409. Replay resolves before new revision comparison; mutation/revision/receipt are atomic.
rows.client_validation: UX-only typed parsing, explicit workspace and no provider secrets; persist a secret-free key/intent fingerprint and require the explicit expected revision. Never auto-rebase 409/412/428, mint a replacement key after uncertainty or cache one-time credential material; the server repeats authorization and contract checks.
rows.server_validation: Authentication, explicit workspace/resource scope and resource grant, typed schema, bounded bytes and admitted capability; reject ceilings broader than the delegator or an unauthorized second hop, and preserve distinct auditable actor/effective actor. Current authorization precedes replay disclosure; missing If-Match is 428 and stale is 412, both zero-effect; exact replay is 200; concurrent equal requests commit one logical mutation.

rows.request_contract: Typed delegation revocation intent including the bound connection/operation/workspace/time ceilings and expiry, If-Match for the target delegation control revision, and a scoped idempotency key bound to workspace/principal/operation/target.
rows.response_contract: Successful revoke or already-revoked unchanged: HTTP 200 safe scoped identity/grant/revision and distinct actor/effective-actor metadata. Exact replay: HTTP 200 explicit replay plus the original safe result/revision, never current authorization state. Never expose a provider credential or one-time PM automation credential.

local_only.ui_equivalent: Deployment URL selection in browser origin/bookmark
local_only.authority: Client profile stores only server URL/instance ID, PM session handle and display settings; no current workspace or provider secret
local_only.reason: Local client preference, not a PM backend use case

shared_rules.workspace: Explicit route scope and --workspace per invocation, never global current-workspace
shared_rules.browser: Same-origin HttpOnly Secure cookie, CSRF token and exact Origin/Host; AbortSignal cancels viewing, not accepted run
shared_rules.cli: Generated Go client plus PM session handle in OS store; expiry/logout affects new API actions, not accepted run grant
shared_rules.admin: Separate authenticated ingress schema excluded ordinary generated SDKs
shared_rules.errors: RFC 9457 application/problem+json plus the exhaustive CONTRACTS AdmissionPolicy status/code/safe_retry_action table; scope-safe detail and incident ID; no resource-existence disclosure or guessed Retry-After.

exit_codes.0: read/action succeeded, or accepted submission explicitly shown when not waiting
exit_codes.6: known terminal failure or partial result when waiting
exit_codes.8: view wait deadline elapsed; run remains accepted

shared_rules.pagination: Opaque signed/scoped keyset cursor binds server, workspace, principal, resource, query, snapshot, filter, order and source revision, with finite page_size; direct provider navigation remains in the operation contract. Provider page size differs from total record cap; preserve effective wire limit, unread tail, continuation, provider completeness and fetched/returned/emitted counts. An empty filtered page is not exhaustion.
shared_rules.events: PG durable sequence exposed as SSE id; scoped retention gap requires snapshot+cursor, never silent reconnect from current tip
shared_rules.action_results: Default action results preserve complete source data, nesting, presence and exact values. Optional typed selection/filtering is shared across Go/CLI/browser; filtering precedes selection and malformed controls cause zero provider I/O.
shared_rules.admission: Use CONTRACTS AdmissionPolicy exact status/code/retry table, finite development/standard profiles and workspace count/age refusals before deployment overload when predicates coincide. Authentication/scope checks precede replay disclosure; accepted work is never discarded by age pressure.
shared_rules.client_recovery: Persist a secret-free key/intent fingerprint before the first client-to-API send and reuse it for reconnect/restart. At most three such sends occur in one 30-second deadline with deterministic 250ms then 1s backoff. A server Retry-After must fit the remaining client deadline; provider/run-owned Retry-After and durable retry scheduling are independent. Never auto-rebase stale control revisions, auto-resubmit 410 or mint a replacement key after uncertainty.
shared_rules.mutation_replay: Service-account and delegation grants retain explicit connection/operation/workspace/time ceilings and distinct auditable actor/effective-actor identities. Six M3 access POST rows require current authorization, If-Match for a new mutation, and workspace/principal/operation/target-scoped idempotency. Exact replay returns HTTP 200 plus the original safe result/revision and explicit replay indication; changed intent is 409; effect/revision/receipt commit atomically.
shared_rules.receipt_retention: Retain full safe response at least 7 days after known resolution; unresolved outcomes have no time expiry. Afterwards retain a secret-free namespace-lifetime refusal guard: exact old intent 410, changed intent 409; workspace deletion never recycles the namespace.
